profile.headline: Computer Software Professional
profile.summary: A flexible and highly motivated software engineer, contributing to the solutions for technical challenges through mathematics, computation and finesse.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented interesting problems for kids to encounter in academic skills. Introduced major improvements to the API. Redesigned automatic, multithreaded testing tools to catch logical and performance issues in content code.  Implemented Javascript building tools to
facilitate back-end unit testing.  

Analyzed and optimized performance in several aspects our stack, ranging from the garbage collector to internal caches to concurrency behaviors.  Wrote designs and documentation for many complex features.  Refactored and simplified legacy code to use more up-to-date technologies.  

Led an internal reading group to foster cooperative learning and professional development software engineers at IXL, topics including effective Java programming, design patterns, and javascript.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Primarily worked with Java and MS SQL Server to manage patient intake process, forecast business metrics using Monte Carlo methods, develop Swing-based UI applications, design a data warehousing system. In addition, developed theoretical and practical mathematical models for various aspects of proton therapy delivery. Also worked on several projects, including an infrared-camera position tracking system, a customized medical equipment QA appliance, and adding new programmability features to a controller for an industrial KUKA robot.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Created an interactive graphics system for optimizing low-dimensional views of high-dimensional manifolds.

positions.title: Programmer/Consultant
positions.description: Worked on several academic programming projects, including those in knot theory, recursion theory, and theroetical physics. Used a wide assortment of technologies, including LATEX, PostScript, PHP, OpenGL, BLAS, Java, C/C++, Lua, Mathematica.

positions.title: Associate Instructor
positions.description: Taught various mathematics courses, including Introduction to Problem Solving, Introduction to College Mathematics, Introduction to Calculus with Applications, Pre-calculus. Assisted for Finite Mathematics and recited for Calculus I/II.

positions.title: Mathematics Instructor
positions.description: Taught several sections of the Intermediate Algebra course.  Responsible for preparing and delivering lectures, grading, and holding office hours.

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered in various capacities in the work with children (3 year old to 12th grade), including organizing, teaching, mentoring, supervising.
Assisted with the construction of an elementary school in Kigali, the capital city of Rwanda.

projects.title: GCalc
projects.description: A graphing calculator application written in Java, designed mainly as a pedagogical tool.  Web site development in PHP/MySQL.  More recent development include improved GUI, multithreading, integrating a custom functional programming language called Juu.

projects.title: NDViewer 3.0
projects.description: A mathematical visualization software to manipulate and optimize low-dimensional views of high-dimensional manifolds.  Written in C++ mostly from scratch, using Qt, OpenGL, and Lua.

publications.title: Higher-order Algebras and Coalgebras from Parameterized Endofunctors
publications.publisher: Electronic Notes in Theoretical Computer Science · Aug 12, 2010

publications.title: Coinductive Properties of Causal Maps
publications.publisher: Lecture Notes in Computer Science · Jan 1, 2008
